summary: Senior Analyst (Senior Associate), Portfolio Analytics candidate with ~7 years of multi-asset investment and risk analytics for pension and institutional portfolios. Ran VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, risk decomposition, and currency, inflation, and duration/leverage overlay analysis at Ortec Finance; now holds delegated sign-off on valuation and sensitivity outputs for $5-25bn multi-asset portfolios at Moody's Analytics. Re-engineers manual workflows into production Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy) and PostgreSQL analytics pipelines. CFA charter, dual MSc.

sections.heading: Multi-Asset Portfolio Analytics & Cross-Asset Valuation
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio risk outputs delivered to multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates.
Review aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream analytics and reporting.
Serve on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

sections.heading: Quantitative Modelling & Scenario Analytics
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across investment horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed projection analytics (T+1 through multi-year) used for funding, liquidity, and asset-allocation decisions.

Oversee duration and interest-rate exposure analysis under parallel and non-parallel curve shocks, incorporating spread calibration across fixed income holdings feeding portfolio-level risk aggregates.

sections.heading: Data Pipelines & AI-Assisted Engineering
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python (pandas, NumPy, SciPy) and PostgreSQL analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls, running shadow cycles before cutover.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation, cutting development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Partnering with Investment Teams
bullets: Act as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, holding releases where outputs lack mathematical or economic defensibility and walking Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders through remediation.
Translate quantitative output into decision-ready narratives on exposure, scenario impacts, and portfolio sensitivities for senior investment stakeholders.

Onboarded U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consultants onto PFaroe DB (risk analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management), scoping investment-team requirements into structured Product Owner requests for development.
Migrated all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to PFaroe PM, validating model outputs post-deployment.

Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 technology-transformation projects for Canadian and international insurers, coordinating actuarial, finance, IT, and risk teams on data sourcing, milestone delivery, and governance documentation.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk budgeting, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed regimes.
Advised institutional clients on Strategic Asset Allocation and Tactical Asset Allocation trade-offs through stress testing and sensitivity analysis.
Conducted cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.
Led the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger on a team of three, developing and validating the model and evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
